rationale: The Latin anchors *emendatio* and *reparatio* both strongly point to the sense of "setting right / making amends," while *compensatio* and *oblatio* reinforce a restorative, remedial action rather than punishment or a technical quantity. OE BÓT in legal contexts (L. Ethb., L. Alf. pol.) denotes compensation or amendment for a wrong, which aligns best with correction.n.01 ("the act of offering an improvement to replace a mistake; setting right").
